unresolved_gaps: Model count: no authenticated December 11 inventory was recovered using a consistent definition of distinct GPT-4-caliber models.
Major advance: the threshold is unspecified, and the evidence does not settle whether advances by December 11 crossed it.
Price wars: announcements support competitive price reductions, but do not establish the economics of every provider.
Moats: multi-provider deployment supports competition, but does not measure all technical, distribution or customer-retention advantages.
Hallucinations: evidence supports persistence, but is not an exhaustive test of every available system.
Lasting corporate adoption: the surveys do not establish a common population, durability window and threshold for modest deployment.
Profits: no comparable industry earnings and distribution data were recovered. The source supplies no accounting basis, and individual losses or cash-burn estimates cannot settle this component.
